citations.quote: The hazard function is of particular interest in default modeling because of its link to conditional default probabilities, which is similar to the link we saw in the discrete-time case.
so h(t) t is approximately the conditional probability of a default in a small interval after t given survival up to and including t.
Credit risk plays an important role in the valuation of convertibles. If credit risk is ignored, poor prices are obtained because the coupons and principal payments on the bond are overvalued.
